title: Measure response
description: Response from POST /measure. One entry per scale-recovery arm (ARCHITECTURE.md section 5). Frozen by TICK-060 before any metrology exists, so client rendering (TICK-063) and the library (TICK-043 onward) proceed in parallel; TICK-061 fills real values in behind this identical shape.

stub.description: True while the endpoint returns fixed placeholder values instead of measurements. TICK-061 sets it false. Clients must surface it, so stub output is never mistaken for a measurement.

capture_id.description: Echoed from the request sidecar, so a response is always tied back to the capture it came from.

arms.description: Keyed by arm name from the metrology registry (TICK-040). Arm A is the primary arm and is always present; A_prime, B and C may be absent, since Arm C can be cut on Sep 2 (D-013) and a capture may not support every arm.

arm_result.description: One arm's answer for one capture: a measurement, its interval, and a decision per ADA line.

rise_in.description: Threshold rise in inches. Always present, including when a decision is abstain.

interval.description: Confidence interval on rise_in, in inches. Method settled by TICK-050; the shape does not depend on which method wins.

decisions.description: One decision per ADA line. The 1/2 inch line is the pre-registered primary and the 1/4 inch line the secondary (PRD.md section 2); they are computed independently, so one may abstain while the other does not.

decision.description: abstain is a first-class outcome (D-009), emitted when the interval straddles the line. It is a decision value, never a missing or null measurement: rise_in and interval_in are present regardless.
